seoTitle: Free Code Comment Stripper for JS, CSS, Python, SQL, HTML and Shell
metaDescription: Remove line and block comments from code without touching strings. Keep license comments if you want. Free and runs in your browser.
intro: Deletes comments from C-style code, CSS, Python, shell, SQL and HTML/XML. Text inside strings is left alone, license comments can be kept, and lines that become empty can be dropped.
why:
You may want to share code without notes, shrink a file by hand or count only real code. A search and replace on // breaks every URL in a string.

The tool walks the text and tracks strings, so "http://x" survives. It is a scanner, not a parser: JavaScript regex literals are handled by a heuristic, and shell comments, heredocs or Python f-strings with nested quotes can confuse it. Check the output before you use it, and keep the original.
howTo: Paste the code and choose the language.
Decide whether to keep license comments and remove empty lines.
Run your own syntax check on it.

faq.a: Yes for normal strings. Comment markers inside them are kept.

faq.q: What counts as a license comment?
faq.a: Block comments starting /*! or /** and anything containing @license or @preserve.
By heuristic only. A regex after an operator or bracket is skipped, which is right for common code.
